exposure: Surgical management of Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP)
Medical management of Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP)
Conservative management of Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: The study included 46 patients diagnosed with Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP) and treated at a single tertiary center.
finding: Surgical management was the most effective approach for managing Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSP), with a 100% success rate compared to 53% for medical management and 0% for conservative management.
